gravitational_detection.description: Only confirmed detection method so far

direct_detection.description: Experiments looking for direct interaction between dark matter and target material
direct_detection.status: Have strongly constrained allowed cross sections due to non-observation

examples: Cosmic rays from supernovae studied by AMS-02 experiment

luminogenesis_model.description: Beyond Standard Model theory connecting dark matter to inflaton
luminogenesis_model.dark_matter_type: CHIMPs (χ Massive Particles) - dark baryons from four χ particles
luminogenesis_model.mass_constraints: Upper bound of ~1 TeV for χ particles from astrophysical observations

self_interacting_dark_matter.description: Framework to solve small-scale structure problems
self_interacting_dark_matter.interaction: Attractive Yukawa-type potential with scalar mediator
self_interacting_dark_matter.cross_section_constraints: 0.1-10 cm²/g depending on scale (dwarf, MW, cluster)

key_findings.coupling_strength: Dark matter-dark energy coupling is very small around present epoch
key_findings.mass_limits: CHIMP dark matter mass limited to ~4 TeV from astrophysical constraints
key_findings.inflation_constraints: Number of e-folds limited to <95 from dark matter mass bounds
